description: Use this when the user wants printable math worksheets ("math worksheets grade 2", "multiplication worksheets", "times tables worksheet", "subtraction worksheet no regrouping", "long division worksheet", "missing number worksheet", "fraction worksheet", "math worksheet with answer key"). If the user pastes or uploads their own problems (text or an image), first convert them into the problems list, one string per problem like "45 - 18", then call. Generates a seeded, reproducible PDF for Letter or A4 with Name, Date and Score lines, problems in column form or on one line, and an answer key on separate pages; answers are computed with whole-number and fraction arithmetic and no problem repeats. Rules: grade K-6, digits like 2 or "3x1", within, min/max numbers, a times table, regrouping none/required, no negative answers, same or different denominators. Returns the problem list with answers, the set number and a PDF link. Does not write word problems, does not grade a child's completed sheet, and does not cover geometry, money, time or algebra.

allow_negative.description: Allow subtraction answers below zero. Default false (no negative answers).

allow_repeats.description: When the rules allow fewer different problems than count, repeat some to reach count. Default false (the worksheet is shortened instead).

answer_key.description: Add answer key pages at the end of the PDF. Default true.

count.description: Problems per worksheet, 1 to 100. Default 20 (12 for long division). Example: 30

denominators.description: Fractions only: like (same denominator), unlike or any. Default like up to grade 4, unlike from grade 5.

digits.description: Digits per number: 2 for 2-digit numbers, or "3x1" for 3-digit by 1-digit (multiplication and long division). Example: "2".

grade.description: School grade K to 6 that sets sensible number sizes, e.g. 2 or "3rd grade" or "K". UK "Year 3" is read as grade 2.

layout.description: vertical (stacked column form, default; division uses the long-division bracket) or horizontal (on one line).

max_denominator.description: Fractions only: largest denominator, 2 to 20. Default 12 (8 up to grade 3).

max_number.description: Largest number to use in the problems, e.g. 12 for times tables up to 12.

min_number.description: Smallest number to use in the problems (factors for multiplication, divisor and answer for division facts), e.g. 2.

missing_number.description: true for fill-in-the-blank problems like 7 + ? = 12. Default false.

name_line.description: Print Name, Date and Score lines. Default true.

operation.description: What to practise: addition, subtraction, multiplication (times tables), division, division with remainders, mixed (all four), "addition and subtraction", missing number, or fractions (adding fractions, subtracting fractions, multiplying fractions). Example: "subtraction". Default: from the grade, else addition.

problems.description: Your own problems instead of generated ones: a list like ["12 + 7", "45 - 18", "6 x 7", "84 ÷ 4", "3/4 + 1/8", "7 + ? = 12"] or [{"a":12,"op":"+","b":7}], or pasted text with one problem per line. Up to 100. The tool computes every answer.

regrouping.description: Carrying/borrowing rule for addition, subtraction and 1-digit multiplication: none (no regrouping), required (every problem regroups) or any (default). Example: "none"

seed.description: Set number from an earlier result to print exactly the same problems again, e.g. 48213. Default: a new random set.

table.description: Times table or fact family to focus on: one number or a list, e.g. 7 or "6, 7, 8" or [3, 4]. For division it is the divisor.

title.description: Title printed at the top, e.g. "Emma's Subtraction Practice". Default: a title from the rules.

versions.description: Number of different worksheets with the same rules (each with its own answer key), 1 to 10. Default 1.

within.description: Keep addition sums and subtraction starting numbers at or below this, e.g. 20 for "addition within 20".

name: generate_math_worksheet
title: Generate math worksheet
